name: Fellwick
subtitle: Habits as trails you walk
shortDescription: Each habit becomes a footpath on its own map. Log a step in one tap, rest at camp on a quiet day, and read a plain-words weekly report.
longDescription:
Fellwick turns every habit into a footpath on a hand-contoured map. Each day you log is one step along it. A quiet day is a detour you can rejoin, and rest is a camp, not a failure.

### Log a Step in One Tap
Open the app and tap Take a step. Or do it from the Home Screen or Lock Screen widget without opening anything. A soft double-tap on the haptics tells you it landed.

### Rest Without Losing Your Place
Every six steps on a trail earns a camp, up to three. If a due day goes quiet you have three days to pitch a camp on it and your stretch carries on. Total distance only grows; nothing resets to zero.

### Your Month As a Route
The 28 days of a leg are waymarks along a winding path through meadow, moor, ridge, tarn and summit. One look shows the shape of your month: inked marks for steps, tents for camps, dotted gaps for detours, fog over the days ahead.

### Any Rhythm
Every day, chosen weekdays, or a few times a week. Count several steps in a day, such as glasses of water.

### Trail Notes
A weekly field report in plain words, worked out on your device: how many steps, which weekday is steepest, and when you usually step so you can move a reminder to match.

### Widgets and Live Activity
Home and Lock Screen widgets with a one-tap Step button, a map widget of your trail, and a Today's leg Live Activity.

### Gentle and Private
No account. Your trails stay on your device. Reminders are quiet, and are skipped once you have logged.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
